stations.title: The plot list
stations.text: A line per plot, read with a finger.

stations.title: Terminal
stations.text: One line: the plot and its holder.

captions: At Marrowfield, someone rings Rhiannon to ask who has plot B3.
The answer is in plots.txt, and she scrolls through it with a finger and loses her place.
You write three scripts that read the society's files, in four tasks.
Now she types the plot and the script prints its holder, and a typo gets a plain line.
Same phone call, no scrolling. The list answers for itself.
